preprocessing.lab_conversion: Standard sRGB->linear->XYZ(D65)->CIE Lab, NOT PIL's Image.convert('LAB'). L in [0,100] -> divide by 100. a,b roughly in [-128,127] -> (val+128)/255, clipped to [0,1].

provenance.training_data: Fine-tuned from ImageNet pre-trained mobilenet_v3_large (CIELAB color space)
